description: This file defines the 'EmailFromValidator' class that is responsible for validating the 'From' address, name, and related fields in email objects within the SuiteCRM project. It includes constants for error codes, validation methods for email address and name formatting, and methods to collect and report validation errors.

classes.name: EmailFromValidator
classes.description: Class to validate and handle 'From' address and name fields within email objects, ensuring they conform to expected formats and are consistent with associated email object properties.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates the email's 'From' address, 'from_addr', 'FromName', 'from_name', and 'from_addr_name' fields, collecting errors if any validations fail.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Sets the email object to be validated.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Retrieves the current email object, throwing an exception if it is not set or of incorrect type.

methods.name: addError
methods.description: Adds a specific error code to the errors list if not already present.

methods.name: addErrors
methods.description: Merges a list of errors into the current errors list, ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns and clears the current list of errors.

methods.name: getErrorsAsText
methods.description: Returns a human-readable text representation of errors and their codes.

methods.name: getErrorAsText
methods.description: Converts a specific error code to its corresponding text label.

methods.name: getErrorTextLabel
methods.description: Maps error codes to message labels used for localization.

methods.name: hasErrors
methods.description: Checks if there are any validation errors.

methods.name: isValidEmailAddress
methods.description: Checks if an email address string is valid using an external validation function.

methods.name: isValidNonEmailAddress
methods.description: Validates that a non-email string appears to be a valid name.

methods.name: isValidFromAddrName
methods.description: Validates a combined name and email address string of the form 'Name <email@domain>'. Checks proper regex match and field consistency.
